tasks.task: Our auth service is failing JWKS validation because the cached keyset for https://auth.example.net/.well-known/jwks.json is marked expired. Before the next peak traffic window (within the next 10 minutes), refresh that JWKS cache entry to a fresh 24-hour TTL using the existing cached payload, then verify it’s readable again and capture the most recent store operation record for audit.

success_criteria: Step 0 returns at least one item (the expired JWKS cache entry) whose cache_key equals "oauth:jwks:https://auth.example.net/.well-known/jwks.json".
Step 1 returns status="active" and ttl=86400 (or an equivalent effective TTL reflecting 24 hours).
Step 2 succeeds and returns status="active" for the same key.
Step 3 returns at least one operation for that cache_key with op_type="store" and result="success" that occurred after the refresh.

tasks.task: We have a security/compliance requirement to purge any expired OAuth JWKS cache artifacts immediately (must be done before end of day today). Find the expired entry for key "oauth:jwks:https://auth.example.net/.well-known/jwks.json" and hard-delete it so it no longer appears in cache metadata, then confirm it’s deleted and that the instance clears counter increased.

success_criteria: Step 0 returns at least one item, and step 1 shows item.cache_key == "oauth:jwks:https://auth.example.net/.well-known/jwks.json".
Step 4 returns no items for status=expired with key_prefix="oauth:jwks:" (or at minimum the previously targeted entry is absent).
Step 5 stats.clears_total is greater than step 2 stats.clears_total.

tasks.task: Our fraud response playbook requires immediately unblocking IP 203.0.113.42 without clearing the whole cache. Find the active rate-limit key for that IP, delete just that one entry, then confirm the entry is deleted and that an audit operation was recorded for the clear between 2026-08-04T00:00:00Z and 2026-08-06T00:00:00Z.

success_criteria: Step 0 returns at least one item whose cache_key starts with "rate_limit:ip:203.0.113.42" (expected to match the real entry "rate_limit:ip:203.0.113.42:window:60s").
Step 1 returns mode=single and includes the cleared key with status=deleted.
Step 2 returns the same entry id from step 0 with status=deleted and a non-null deleted_at timestamp.
Step 3 returns at least one operation item for op_type=clear with cache_key equal to the cleared key within the specified time window.
